description: This file defines an Android Fragment called LogFragment, which contains a LogView used for displaying log data within a ScrollView. It handles view creation, layout setup, and text change listening to enable dynamic log display in an Android app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log information using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, with capabilities to automatically scroll as new log data is appended.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets their layout parameters, style, and padding, and arranges the view hierarchy.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to create the view hierarchy, inflates the views, and adds a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when the log updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView component for external access.
